reviewScope: All 1,423 photographs fully decoded and visually reviewed in 23 chronological contact sheets. All 67 shortlisted photographs checked again in larger comparison sheets at up to 492 pixels; covers opened at 1,000 pixels. One additional lake-cover alternative was checked individually. Videos and hidden metadata sidecars remain outside the still-photo album.
dateSource: Camera-recorded EXIF DateTimeOriginal calendar dates, with inconsistent or missing offset tags kept explicit.
locationNotes: No usable numeric GPS occurs in the Sikkim sources. MG Road, Nathu La, Tsomgo Lake and Baba Harbhajan Singh shrine are supported by photographed signs, landscape and capture order. Unnamed river and road stops keep broad Teesta Valley labels.
The station sign in 20220403_195609.jpg explicitly reads New Jalpaiguri.

The 63 COOLPIX rafting photographs have zero EXIF dates; the same rafting activity is documented by dated 3 April phone originals. Only dated originals are selected, without transferring a date to the undated sequence.

Samsung phone offset tags change among +05:30, +05:45, +06:00 and +08:00 during the continuous mountain outing. Preserve the original DateTimeOriginal calendar day and reported offset separately; no UTC conversion or clock-synchronization claim is made.
Some filenames and shared-copy filenames disagree with EXIF dates. EXIF takes precedence; undated WhatsApp copies and the destination-list graphic are omitted.
People and some personal scenes are included without identifying or matching faces; their source filenames are listed for owner review.
criteria: Select distinct scenery, architecture, wildlife, food, details and daily life; omit most posed portrait bursts and visually repeated views.
Aim for around ten strong photographs per day/location where available; do not pad shorter stops.
Use the cover once outside the gallery, counted on its actual capture day.
Preserve original framing and colour; correct orientation. Export quality-84 WebP at up to 2,000 pixels long edge, 2,400 for the cover. Retain source ICC profiles; omit EXIF/XMP.
Keep originals, videos, sidecars, review sheets and credentials outside Git and R2.
